dog.description_text:
Meet Brooklyn!

Brooklyn is the kind of dog who walks into a room and brings a little more happiness with him. This handsome guy found himself in our care when his owners realized they could no longer give him the time and attention he deserves. It wasn't his fault, and now we're determined to find him the family he's been waiting for.

Brooklyn is an upbeat, happy-go-lucky guy who is eager to learn and excited to experience life with his people. He's smart, willing to please, and ready for someone who will give him the time, guidance, and attention he deserves.

He's got plenty of personality, lots of love to give, and so much potential to become an incredible companion. Brooklyn deserves a family who will make him part of their everyday life, not just someone who has a place for him, but someone who truly has time for him.

Please don't let this beautiful boy wait. Brooklyn is ready for his forever home.If you're looking for an enthusiastic, loving companion who is eager to learn and ready to be your best friend, he may be the one you've been searching for.

Want to learn more?We'd love to tell you! Our bios are just a snapshot, so please reach out to our adoption team with any questions about this dog's personality, medical history, or ideal home. We'd be happy to help you determine if Brooklyn is the perfect match for your family.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
